related.title: Lattice Surgery：邏輯閘的時空體積
related.titleEn: Lattice surgery: spacetime volume of a logical operation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用固定偵測資料集驗證權重更新，並記錄邏輯錯誤率而非只配對總權重。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Validate weight updates on a fixed detection dataset and report logical errors, not merely matching cost. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 以量子位元×週期計算簡化時空成本，避免只比較同時使用位元數。
related.differenceEn: Calculate simplified qubit-cycle cost instead of comparing simultaneous qubit counts alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。單邊錯誤率p=0.01，對數採自然底；只分析一個局部圖邊。 w=ln(0.99/0.01)。 代入 log((1-0.01)/0.01)，得到 4.59512 log-odds units。獨立圖邊錯誤模型的權重w=ln[(1−p)/p]；相關超邊與退化情況可能需更完整解碼。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。碼距d=5、三區塊同時存在，忽略路由與狀態工廠。 V=3×49×5。 代入 3*(2*5**2-1)*5，得到 735 qubit-cycles。教學排程用三個面積2d²−1的區塊持續d週期，體積V=3(2d²−1)d；不是完整CNOT排程。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. One edge hasp=0.01 with natural logarithms; analyze a local edge only. w=ln(0.99/0.01). Substituting log((1-0.01)/0.01) gives 4.59512 log-odds units. Independent graph-edge errors usew=ln[(1−p)/p]; correlated hyperedges and degeneracy can require richer decoding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Distanced=5, three simultaneous patches, excluding routing and state factories. V=3×49×5. Substituting 3*(2*5**2-1)*5 gives 735 qubit-cycles. A teaching schedule holds three2d²−1 patches ford cycles:V=3(2d²−1)d; this is not a fullCNOT schedule. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
